Before anything else, we recommend you read the [Sampling Protocol](../protocols/pro.qmd). If you have already done so and want to participate in the project...

Join by providing your details and the areas you wish to sample in this [form](https://forms.gle/P3N1jEVUXahPpKys5)

Or if you have any questions, you can contact us through {{< fa envelope >}}   [anthuntersproject\@gmail.com](mailto:anthuntersproject@gmail.com)

Thank you for your interest in helping science and discovering more about the ants in your surroundings! After completing your samplings, we will send you a certificate of participation and a small report on the ant communities obtained from your samplings.
